entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, your partner in performance. For English, press one. Para Español, oprima dos.
(beep)
Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I think I need to make a return? I'm a bit lost. It's for the VeloBand sensor I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please get your full name and order number?
Yes, it's Maria Flores. The order number is... uhm... VF55198.

Thank you, Maria. One moment. Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. Now, to make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it works fine, I think. To be honest, I just... I completely changed my mind about it. It was a total impulse buy.
I see. And you're not finding it useful for your workouts?

No, I really don't use it at all. It's still in the box. I thought it tracked something else when I bought it, the website was a little confusing for me. Can't you just help me? This is all so overwhelming.

Of course, Maria, I'm here to help. I understand completely. Let me just check the policy for you. I see you're at day 39. Sometimes for items outside the initial window, we suggest our VeloFit resale marketplace as an option.
Oh no, a marketplace? That sounds so complicated. I wouldn't even know where to start.
No worries at all. Let me just take a closer look at the item policy... one second. Ah, you're in luck. The VeloBand Cadence Sensor falls under our standard 10-day return policy.
It does? Oh, thank goodness!

Yes, so you are well within the timeframe for a full refund. I've just approved the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address we have on file. Do you still have access to that one?
Yes, I do! Oh, that's such a relief. Thank you so, so much, Isaac. You've made this so easy.

You are very welcome, Maria. Just print that label, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
